entries.text: Post-load clustering on PostgreSQL-family adapters no longer fails with `CLUSTER cannot run inside a transaction block`. Plain `postgresql` runs with a clustering or sorting tuning previously recorded the `CREATE INDEX` and `CLUSTER` as failed. The index now commits first and `CLUSTER` runs in autocommit; both partitioning (`pg_get_partkeydef`) and clustering (`pg_index.indisclustered`, per partition) are verified against the catalog. A verification failure after commit records the durable statements as executed and the intent as not satisfied.
